what_it_shows: A group of golfers and caddies walks down a sloping fairway in low evening light, with fescue-covered ridges and a lone oak behind.
Elevated view of a group with caddies on a green in a bowl of tall fescue mounds at golden hour, autumn trees on the horizon.
A dirt walking path cuts through waist-high golden fescue toward a bunkered green in morning haze.
Aerial view of tees, fairway and winding paths running through rolling glacial terrain covered in tan fescue.
A bunkered green sits below layered fescue ridges and a treeline in warm late-day light.
Elevated view over a large green and ragged-edged bunker toward rolling fescue hills, ponds and a winding path at sunset.
Two golfers stand on the 4th fairway beside their carry-stand bags, looking up the hole past ragged fairway bunkers.
Golfers walk the 4th fairway as it climbs between fescue-covered ridges toward the green.
